verdict.rationale: Synthesia's own docs say it can create an avatar from a single photo. That is a narrow form of animating a still image into a moving presenter that keeps the subject's likeness. Nothing in the pack shows general image-to-video animation of arbitrary stills, and the photo-to-avatar claim is only a thin homepage line. Missing for 10: general image-to-video for arbitrary scenes and non-avatar subjects, evidence that the original composition and framing are preserved, motion controls, in-depth docs, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can animate a still image into motion with the subject and composition preserved

citations.quote: Create an avatar of yourself from a single photo, for more personal videos.
